scripts.check:production-config: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const config=fs.readFileSync('wrangler.jsonc','utf8');if(config.includes('00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003')){console.error('Production deploy blocked: replace the placeholder D1 database ID in wrangler.jsonc.');process.exit(1)}if(process.env.CORINTH_RELEASE_APPROVED!=='true'){console.error('Production deploy blocked: migration/runtime verification and explicit CORINTH_RELEASE_APPROVED=true are required.');process.exit(1)}"
scripts.deploy: npm run check:production-config && npm run build:production && wrangler deploy --env production
scripts.deploy:dry: npm run check:production-config && npm run build:production && wrangler deploy --dry-run --env production
scripts.db:migrate:remote: npm run check:production-config && wrangler d1 migrations apply corinths-plight-production --remote --env production
scripts.db:seed:local: npm run db:seed:core:local && npm run db:seed:phase2:local && npm run db:seed:equipment:local && npm run db:seed:onboarding:local
scripts.db:seed:demo:local: npm run db:seed:demo:forces:local && npm run db:seed:demo:strategic:local && npm run db:seed:demo:spearhead:local
scripts.db:seed:core:remote: npm run check:production-config && wrangler d1 execute corinths-plight-production --remote --env production --file seeds/v5-core-curated.sql
scripts.db:seed:phase2:remote: npm run check:production-config && wrangler d1 execute corinths-plight-production --remote --env production --file seeds/v5-phase2-combined-arms.sql
scripts.db:seed:equipment:remote: npm run check:production-config && wrangler d1 execute corinths-plight-production --remote --env production --file seeds/v5-equipment-deployment.sql
scripts.db:seed:onboarding:remote: npm run check:production-config && wrangler d1 execute corinths-plight-production --remote --env production --file seeds/onboarding-foundation.sql
scripts.db:seed:remote: npm run db:seed:core:remote && npm run db:seed:phase2:remote && npm run db:seed:equipment:remote && npm run db:seed:onboarding:remote
